Delete your Tracksy account

You can request deletion of your Tracksy account and associated personal data even if you cannot open the app.

Request deletion by email

  1. Email souravsharma191919@gmail.com from the email address registered with Tracksy.
  2. Use the subject Tracksy account deletion and state that you want your account and associated personal data deleted.
  3. Support will verify account ownership and explain any remaining steps, the processing timeline and any records that need to be retained. Do not send your password or verification codes.
Request account deletion

This button opens your email app. Send the email to submit your request; opening this page alone does not submit or complete deletion.

Request deletion in the app

Sign in, open Profile / Account → Account deletion → Request account deletion, then confirm. This records a request for manual processing. If you own a group, transfer ownership or archive it before requesting deletion. Email support if you cannot complete that step.

What happens to data?

Account access, profile information and other identifiable data are reviewed for removal after ownership verification. Shared expense, settlement and audit records may need to remain for other members, dispute resolution, security or legal obligations. Support will identify any retained data and its retention period when processing your request. Copies previously downloaded by other members and service-provider backups cannot necessarily be removed immediately.

Important: The current testing release uses a manual deletion process. A deletion request does not instantly erase your account or shared financial records.

Delete specific information instead

You can use the same email address to request deletion or correction of specific personal data without closing your account. Describe the information and the relevant group, without sending sensitive payment credentials.

For more information, see the Tracksy privacy policy.
